block.createmoderntech.speaker: Speaker
createmoderntech.ponder.volumetric_displ: The Volumetric Display reads the surrounding terrain and projects a hologram
The faster the input RPM, the more geometry the hologram will show
Lenses can be placed on top to magnify or zoom the projection
A lens setup can be extended using lens extensions
A lens at the bottom will scale the projection down by the strength
A lens at the top will scale the projection up by the strength
Instead of regular shafts, volumetric shafts can be used
Controllers can be attached anywhere on the shaft column to manipulate the projection
Pitch tilts the projection forward and back
Pan X shifts the sampled area east or west
Pan Z shifts the sampled area east or west
Each controller's shaft speed determines how fast the parameter changes
Instead of regular lens extensions, special ones can be used
The first of these special extensions is the telephoto extension
It offsets the projection by 0.5 blocks per extension
Next up is the light boost filter
It will boost the opacity of the projection by 20 percent
Finally, color filters can be used to tune the color of the projection
Color filters can be mixed to create many different color combinations
createmoderntech.ponder.beacon_controlle: The beacon controller attaches to a volumetric shaft
When powered from the top, a beacon will be placed in the volume
If the bottom is powered when a beacon is not hovered, nothing happens
However, if a beacon is hovered, powering the bottom of the beacon controller...
This compass can be extracted by something like a mechanical arm
The compass will then point to the selected beacon
A warp gate starts with a warp drive which supplies the energy
Then, a warp gate terminal forms the base of the warp gate
The warp gate terminal can support a max gate radius of 10 blocks. If the radius of the gate is larger than that...
Warp amplifiers can be added in between to extend the radius by 8 blocks each
The maximum gate radius is 50 blocks (with 5 amplifiers), and the minimum radius is 8 blocks
By placing a gate block directly above the terminal at the desired diameter and clicking the terminal with a wrench...
It will show exactly where warp gate blocks need to be placed
If the shape is fully built, powering the warp drive will activate the gate
createmoderntech.ponder.gate_working.tex: Using the filter slots, a gate frequency can be set up.
For a ship to travel through a gate, a transponder needs to be on board that is powered by rotational force
If the ship travels fast enough...
It will travel to the warp dimension
It will stay there for a little while, until...
...the ship comes out of the destination gate
createmoderntech.ponder.ai_system.text_1: The ai core is the center of an ai network
createmoderntech.ponder.ai_system.text_2: Clicking the ai core block with an audio trigger or speaker item will link it to the network
createmoderntech.ponder.ai_system.text_3: The ai network also works on simulated contraptions
createmoderntech.ponder.audio_trigger.te: The audio trigger will transmit a message for the ai to read out
When surrounded by certain blocks, the audio trigger can read information from them
To read from a block, provide the direction like this: %N, %S etc.
